integrity: The theorem rests on the published complete facet classification, specialized explicitly to block paths. Two opposite-endpoint upper facet normals give an all-centers global upper bound, attained by explicit even/odd center vectors. All optimal centers satisfy three independent equalities, and strict relative-feasibility perturbations give the matching affine-dimension lower bound. A standalone verifier independently enumerates facets and solves small-dimensional linear programs.
scientific_limitations: Standard unweighted zero-inclusive interval incidence coordinates only; not affine invariant. The full incenter set is described by finite facet inequalities and its dimension, but its vertex enumeration is not supplied. No theorem for branched block trees or arbitrary connected-block graphs.
title: Block-path connected-block polytopes have parity-split inradii and large incenter loci
